recipe.visualDefinition: A sepia-toned, painterly depiction of a classic city brownstone facade where oversized, surreal white flowers grow from the stoop, one of which contains a miniature figure playing a trumpet.
coreVisualRelationships: The giant white flowers contrast against the monochromatic brown architecture.
The verticality of the building windows mirrors the stacked arrangement of the text block.
The miniature musician is nested within the largest flower petal on the right side.
coreInvariants: Monochromatic earthy brown color palette for the background.
Symmetrical architectural layout of windows and stoops.
Surreal scale shift between the flowers and the building.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The surreal flowers occupy the lower third and right-middle ground; the building facade serves as a full-frame grid background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The largest flower on the right containing the musician acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bottom stoop flowers, move up the right-side giant flower to the musician, then up to the stacked text block.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper left quadrant of the building facade provides breathing room for the background texture.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Terracotta and burnt umber (building and environment).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a warm, aged patina; high value contrast between the white flowers and the dark brown shadows.

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing (kerning) causing characters to touch
Uniform stroke weight with rounded terminals
Stacked, center-aligned layout with varying line lengths
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'G' has a deep, inward-curving tail
The 'R' has a short, rounded leg
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family weight variations or complementary hand-drawn scripts.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Paint a sepia-toned urban brownstone facade with symmetrical windows and stoops. In the foreground, paint large, surreal white lilies or trumpet-shaped flowers growing from the stairs. On the right, a giant flower should hold a small man playing a trumpet.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add center-aligned, stacked uppercase text in a bold, rounded yellow sans-serif in the upper right. Ensure the letters are tightly spaced and the lines are closely leaded.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly warm and earthy?
Are the flowers significantly larger than the building's architectural details?
Is the text block tightly packed and centered?

adjustableVariables: Density of the flowers on the stoop
Specific instrument played by the miniature figure
Number of windows visible in the background
mustRedesign: RCA and Victor logos must be removed
Specific artist names must be replaced with placeholder text
postGenerationChecks: Check that the white of the flowers is the brightest element.
Ensure the text does not obscure the musician figure.
Verify the building texture looks like weathered stone or brick.
Confirm the yellow text has a slight 'glow' or high contrast against the brown.
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Architecture + Surreal Botanical Elements + 1970s Rounded Typography + Monochromatic Earth Tones
